fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-01-21, the complainant left a maroon scooter bearing registration number TN-72-YY-1067 near Tamarai Garden Parking Area and could not find it later. The time of the incident was given as 05:15 on 2026-01-21. Contact details given by the complainant, Harish Subramani, include the number 9000000398. A witness, Abirami Sekar, reachable on 9000000186, was mentioned in the complaint. Arun Babu (mobile 9000000379) was named as a possible person of interest. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00243, as the mobile number 9000000379 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
